  lastName: $('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.lastName,

  street: $('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.street,
  houseNumber: $('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.houseNumber,
  city: $('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.city,
  zipCode: $('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.zipCode,
  countryCode: $('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.countryCode,
};

const invoiceAddress = {
  lastName: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.lastName,
  firstName: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.firstName,
  street: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.street,
  houseNumber: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.houseNumber,
  city: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.city,
  zipCode: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.zipCode,
  countryCode: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.countryCode,
};

const similar = JSON.stringify(deliveryAddress) === JSON.stringify(invoiceAddress);

return {
  similar,
  deliveryAddress: {
    ...deliveryAddress,
    countryCode: localization[$('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.countryCode].code,
    lang: localization[$('Order item').item.json.deliveryAddress.countryCode].lang,
    email: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.email

    email: $('Order item').item.json.invoiceAddress.email
  }
};

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "call",
  "params": {
    "service": "object",
    "method": "execute_kw",
    "args": [
      "{{ $('ACME | Odoo').item.json.x_studio_sql_name }}",
      {{ $('ACME | Odoo').item.json.x_studio_user }},
      "{{ $('ACME | Odoo').item.json.x_studio_api }}",
      "res.partner",
      "write",
      [
        [{{ $('Find main customer').item.json.result[0].id }}],
        {
          "name": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.firstName }} {{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.lastName }}",
          "country_id": {{ $('Country IDs').item.json.result[0].id }},
          "city": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.city }}",
          "street": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.street }} {{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.houseNumber }}",
          "zip": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.zipCode }}",
          "email": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.email }}",
          "mobile": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.phoneNumber || "+4942214577700"}}",
          "lang": "{{ $('Addresses').item.json.deliveryAddress.lang }}"
        }
      ]
    ]
  }
}
